units.source_text: 藤壶皇后觉得进宫去很乏味，没有面子，所以很久不去了。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo found going to the palace tedious and humiliating, so she had not gone for a long time.

units.source_text: 然而不见皇太子，心中又常常挂念。

en.t: Yet when she did not see the Crown Prince, she often found herself worrying about him.

units.source_text: 皇太子别无后援人，万事全赖源氏大将照拂。

en.t: The Crown Prince had no other supporter, and in everything he depended entirely on the care of General Genji.

units.source_text: 然而他那种不良之心还未消除，动辄使藤壶皇后痛心疾首。

en.t: But that improper desire of his had still not faded, and it constantly caused Empress Fujitsubo bitter anguish.

units.source_text: 她想：“幸而桐壶院直到驾崩完全没有知道我们那件暧昧之事。

en.t: She thought, "Fortunately, the Kiritsubo院 never learned anything about that ambiguous affair between us before his death.

units.source_text: 我现在想起此事，还是惶恐万状。

en.t: Even now, when I think of it, I am still filled with terror and shame.

units.source_text: 今后如果泄露出去，我自身姑置不论，对皇太子定然不利。”

en.t: If it should come to light in the future, never mind what happens to me, it would surely harm the Crown Prince."

units.source_text: 她恐怖之极，竟为此修荐法事，欲仰仗佛力来斩断情丝，又想尽方法逃出情网。

en.t: She was so terrified that she even held memorial Buddhist rites for this, hoping to rely on the Buddha's power to sever the bonds of passion, and she tried every possible way to escape the snare of love.

units.source_text: 不料有一天，源氏大将居然偷偷地混进藤壶皇后的房室里来了！

en.t: Unexpectedly, one day General Genji actually slipped in secret into Empress Fujitsubo's chambers!
